name: Stay Level Dataset
description: Stay-level analytic file representing nursing home stays identified from MDS entry and discharge tracking records. Contains one record per stay and provides information on admission, discharge, facility utilization, and stay characteristics for individuals observed in MDS.

content.bene_id: String: Encrypted beneficiary identifier used to uniquely identify residents across MDS records.
content.year: Int64: Calendar year corresponding to the start date of the nursing home stay.
content.fac_id: String: CMS facility identifier associated with the nursing home stay.
content.adm_asmt_id: String: Assessment identifier corresponding to the admission or entry tracking record initiating the stay.
content.discharge_asmt_id: String: Assessment identifier corresponding to the discharge tracking record ending the stay.
content.stay_id: String: unique identifier for a nursing home stay, generated from the beneficiary identifier, facility identifier, and admission assessment identifier.
content.admission_date: Date32[day]: Date on which the beneficiary was admitted to the nursing home stay.
content.discharge_date: Date32[day]: Date on which the beneficiary was discharged from the facility. Same as stay_end_date.
content.stay_start_date: Date32[day]: Start date of the nursing home stay, corresponding to the resident's entry date into the facility.
content.stay_end_date: Date32[day]: End date of the nursing home stay, corresponding to the resident's discharge date from the facility.
content.stay_length_days: Int64: Length of the nursing home stay in days, calculated as stay end date minus stay start date plus one day.
content.entry_type: String: Code indicating the type of nursing home admission. Values: '1' = Admission, '2' = Reentry
content.entered_from: String: The data in this column identifies from where the resident was admitted. Values include: 01=Community (private home/apt.,board/care,assisted living, group home), 02=Another nursing home or swing bed, 03=Acute hospital, 04=Psychiatric hospital, 05=Inpatient rehabilitation facility, 06= ID/DD facility, 07=Hospice, 09=Long Term Care Hospital (LTC), 99=Other
content.discharge_record_type: String: Type of discharge tracking record. Values: 10=Discharge assessment - return not anticipated, 11=Discharge assessment - return anticipated, 12=Death in facility record tracking record.
content.discharge_status: String: Resident status or destination at discharge from the nursing facility. Values include: 01=Community (private home/apt.,board/care,assisted living, group home), 02=Another nursing home or swing bed, 03=Acute hospital, 04=Psychiatric hospital, 05=Inpatient rehabilitation facility, 06=ID/DD facility, 07=Hospice, 08=Deceased, 09=Long Term Care Hospital (LTCH), 99=Other.
content.episode_number: Int64: Sequential episode number assigned within each beneficiary-facility combination based on MDS reentry and interrupted stay rules. Episodes are ordered chronologically by stay start date.
content.episode_start_date: Date32[day]: Start date of the nursing home episode, corresponding to the beginning of the first stay within the episode.
content.episode_end_date: Date32[day]: End date of the nursing home episode, corresponding to the end of the final stay within the episode.
content.episode_length_days: Int64: Total duration of the nursing home episode in days, calculated as episode end date minus episode start date plus one day.
content.n_assessments_in_stay: Int64: Number of non-tracking MDS assessment records with assessment reference dates falling within the stay start and end dates.
